posts.subject: Re:Wypalenie OLED w Lenovo Legion Pro 7
posts.author: Ania_Lenovo
posts.message_html:
Hello vishwateja25,

Thank you for your question regarding the OLED protection feature on your new Legion 7 Pro laptop.

To enable the OLED burn-in protection feature, please follow the steps below:

  1. Update Lenovo Vantage: Make sure you have the latest version of the Lenovo Vantage app installed. You can download or update the app here.

  2. Check Settings: After updating the app, open Lenovo Vantage and go to the "Display Settings" section. There should be an option related to OLED protection there.

  3. Video Instructions: If you are still having difficulties, I recommend watching our tutorial videos on the Lenovo Service Videos channel, where you will find detailed instructions on various features and settings.

If after following the above steps you still do not see the OLED protection option, it may be a device-specific issue. In that case, I suggest contacting our technical support directly through Contact Lenovo Support or submitting a Service Request.

I hope this information proves helpful. If you have any additional questions, please do not hesitate to ask.
